extends RefCounted
## Authoring pass for beach_01. Never changes gameplay geometry or uses the layout RNG.
## The baked result is ordinary scene content, not a runtime generator.
## This authoring pass owns/replaces Dressing; edit this file to retain hand changes.

const DIR: String = "res://game/world/handmade/dressing/"
const SCENE: String = DIR + "beach_01_dressing.tscn"
const KIT: Script = preload("res://game/world/scenery_kit.gd")
const BOULDER: String = "res://assets/models/polyhaven/boulder_01/boulder_01_game.glb"
static var _problems: Array[String] = []
static var _mesh_cache: Dictionary = {}

static func apply(island: HandmadeIsland) -> Array[String]:
	_problems.clear()
	_mesh_cache.clear()
	for id: String in KIT.BEACH + KIT.COASTAL:
		if not ResourceLoader.exists(KIT.path(id)):
			_problems.append("Missing scenery piece: " + id)
	if not ResourceLoader.exists(BOULDER):
		_problems.append("Missing prepared Boulder 01")
	for house: Node3D in island.get_node("Buildings").get_children():
		if not house.basis.is_equal_approx(Basis.IDENTITY):
			_problems.append("Re-author the facade placement for rotated building: " + str(house.name))
	if not _problems.is_empty():
		return _problems.duplicate()
	DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(DIR)
	var map_problems: Array[String] = []
	var map: IslandMap = island.build_map(map_problems)
	if not map_problems.is_empty():
		return map_problems
	var old: Node = island.get_node_or_null("Decor/Dressing")
	if old != null:
		old.free()
	var dressing := Node3D.new()
	dressing.name = "Dressing"
	for label: String in ["Facades", "Shore", "RockSurfaces", "HorrorOnly"]:
		var group := Node3D.new()
		group.name = label
		dressing.add_child(group)
		dressing.get_node(label).owner = dressing
	dressing.get_node("HorrorOnly").visible = false
	island.get_node("Decor").add_child(dressing)
	_buildings(island, dressing, map)
	_rocks(island, dressing, map)
	_shore(island, dressing, map)
	_ground(island, map)
	if not _problems.is_empty():
		return _problems.duplicate()
	var packed := PackedScene.new()
	if packed.pack(dressing) != OK or not _save(packed, SCENE):
		_problems.append("Could not pack the beach dressing")
		return _problems.duplicate()
	_canonical_scene(SCENE)
	if not _problems.is_empty():
		return _problems.duplicate()
	dressing.free()
	var saved: PackedScene = load(SCENE) as PackedScene
	if saved == null:
		_problems.append("The saved dressing scene could not reload")
		return _problems.duplicate()
	var instance: Node3D = saved.instantiate()
	island.get_node("Decor").add_child(instance)
	instance.owner = island
	island.set_meta("beach_visual_pilot", true)
	return _problems.duplicate()

static func _save(resource: Resource, path: String) -> bool:
	var result: Error = ResourceSaver.save(resource, path)
	if result != OK:
		_problems.append("Could not save %s: %s" % [path, error_string(result)])
	return result == OK

static func _canonical_scene(path: String) -> void:
	var text: String = FileAccess.get_file_as_string(path)
	var ids := RegEx.create_from_string('\\[(?:sub|ext)_resource[^\\n]* id="([^"]+)"')
	var index: int = 0
	for match: RegExMatch in ids.search_all(text):
		text = text.replace('"' + match.get_string(1) + '"', '"BeachResource_%03d"' % index)
		index += 1
	text = RegEx.create_from_string(" unique_id=[0-9]+").sub(text, "", true)
	var output := FileAccess.open(path, FileAccess.WRITE)
	if output == null:
		_problems.append("Could not canonicalize " + path)
		return
	output.store_string(text)
	output.close()

static func _surface(id: String, scale: float) -> StandardMaterial3D:
	var material := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	var source: String = "res://assets/textures/polyhaven/" + id
	material.albedo_texture = load(source + "_diffuse.res")
	material.normal_enabled = true
	material.normal_texture = load(source + "_nor_gl.res")
	material.roughness_texture = load(source + "_rough.res")
	material.uv1_triplanar = true
	material.uv1_scale = Vector3.ONE * scale
	material.texture_filter = BaseMaterial3D.TEXTURE_FILTER_LINEAR_WITH_MIPMAPS_ANISOTROPIC
	material.take_over_path(DIR + id + ".tres")
	_save(material, material.resource_path)
	return material

static func _packed_surface(id: String, scale: float) -> StandardMaterial3D:
	var material := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	var source: String = "res://assets/textures/polyhaven/" + id
	material.albedo_texture = load(source + "_albedo_height.res")
	material.normal_enabled = true
	material.normal_texture = load(source + "_normal_rough.res")
	material.roughness_texture = material.normal_texture
	material.roughness_texture_channel = BaseMaterial3D.TEXTURE_CHANNEL_ALPHA
	material.uv1_triplanar = true
	material.uv1_scale = Vector3.ONE * scale
	material.texture_filter = BaseMaterial3D.TEXTURE_FILTER_LINEAR_WITH_MIPMAPS_ANISOTROPIC
	material.take_over_path(DIR + id + ".tres")
	_save(material, material.resource_path)
	return material

static func _buildings(island: HandmadeIsland, dressing: Node3D, map: IslandMap) -> void:
	var plaster: Material = _surface("white_plaster_02", 0.45)
	var tiles: Material = _surface("clay_roof_tiles_02", 0.5)
	var timber: Material = _surface("weathered_planks", 0.5)
	var stone: Material = _surface("stone_wall_02", 0.35)
	var path: Material = _packed_surface("rocky_trail", 0.22)
	for house: Node3D in island.get_node("Buildings").get_children():
		var body: MeshInstance3D = house.get_node("Body")
		body.material_override = plaster
		if not house.name.begins_with("Hut_"):
			body.material_override = stone
			continue
		house.get_node("Roof").material_override = tiles
		var centre: Vector3 = house.position
		var face := Vector3(centre.x, 0, centre.z + 3.02)
		# Facade pivots are centred on the wall contact face, not on the floor.
		var door_y: float = map.ground_y(face) + 1.135
		var door: Node3D = _piece("door_frame", dressing.get_node("Facades"), centre + Vector3(0, 0, 3.02), 0)
		door.position.y = door_y
		for x: float in [-2.0, 2.0]:
			_piece("window_shutters", dressing.get_node("Facades"), centre + Vector3(x, 1.65, 3.025), 0, 0.75)
		_piece("wall_lantern", dressing.get_node("Facades"), centre + Vector3(0.95, 2.4, 3.025), 0, 0.8)
		_piece("chimney", dressing.get_node("Facades"), centre + Vector3(2.3, 4.3, -0.8), PI * 0.5)
		if house.name in [&"Hut_01", &"Hut_04"]:
			_piece("canvas_awning", dressing.get_node("Facades"), centre + Vector3(0, 2.55, 3.025), 0)
		if house.name == &"Hut_04":
			_piece("tavern_sign", dressing.get_node("Facades"), centre + Vector3(-3.52, 2.35, 1), -PI * 0.5)
	# The tower's balcony is ornamental; no new walkable upper floor is implied.
	var tower: Node3D = island.get_node("Buildings/Tower_01")
	_piece("small_balcony", dressing.get_node("Facades"), tower.position + Vector3(0, 5.5, 3.52), 0)
	for y: float in [2.0, 6.2]:
		_piece("window_shutters", dressing.get_node("Facades"), tower.position + Vector3(0, y, 3.525), 0, 0.8)
	for bridge: MeshInstance3D in island.get_node("Bridges").get_children():
		bridge.material_override = timber
		for rail: MeshInstance3D in bridge.get_children():
			rail.material_override = timber
	island.get_node("Decor/Roads/Surface").material_override = path

static func _piece(id: String, parent: Node3D, at: Vector3, yaw: float, size: float = 1.0) -> Node3D:
	var source: Node3D = KIT.build(id)
	var result := Node3D.new()
	result.name = id.to_pascal_case() + "_%02d" % parent.get_child_count()
	parent.add_child(result)
	result.owner = parent.owner
	_clone_geometry(source, result, Transform3D.IDENTITY, id)
	source.free()
	result.position = at
	result.rotation.y = yaw
	result.scale = Vector3.ONE * size
	return result

static func _clone_geometry(source: Node3D, target: Node3D, parent_transform: Transform3D, id: String) -> void:
	var transform: Transform3D = parent_transform * source.transform
	if source is MeshInstance3D:
		var mesh_instance := MeshInstance3D.new()
		var key: String = id + "/" + str(source.name)
		if not _mesh_cache.has(key):
			var copy: ArrayMesh = source.mesh.duplicate()
			for i in copy.get_surface_count():
				copy.surface_set_material(i, KIT.material())
			_mesh_cache[key] = copy
		var mesh: ArrayMesh = _mesh_cache[key]
		mesh_instance.name = "Geometry_%02d" % target.get_child_count()
		mesh_instance.mesh = mesh
		mesh_instance.transform = transform
		target.add_child(mesh_instance)
		mesh_instance.owner = target.owner
	for child: Node in source.get_children():
		if child is Node3D:
			_clone_geometry(child, target, transform, id)

static func _rocks(island: HandmadeIsland, dressing: Node3D, map: IslandMap) -> void:
	# Existing rocks keep their exact visible silhouette and camera proxy.
	var material: Material = _surface("rock_face_03", 0.45)
	for original: Node3D in island.get_node("Rocks").get_children():
		original.visible = true
		for part: MeshInstance3D in original.find_children("*", "MeshInstance3D", true, false):
			part.material_override = material
	# New scanned outcrops are on already-blocked shoreline, never tiny stand-ins
	# for large invisible obstacles.
	var source: Node3D = (load(BOULDER) as PackedScene).instantiate()
	var mesh: Mesh = source.find_children("*", "MeshInstance3D", true, false)[0].mesh
	for i in 8:
		var rock := MeshInstance3D.new()
		rock.name = "CoastalOutcrop_%02d" % i
		rock.mesh = mesh
		rock.rotation.y = i * 1.17
		rock.scale = Vector3.ONE * (1.3 + (i % 3) * 0.35)
		rock.set_meta("ground_embed", mesh.get_aabb().size.y * rock.scale.y * 0.2)
		dressing.get_node("RockSurfaces").add_child(rock)
		rock.owner = dressing
		var target := Vector2(99 + i * 8, 220 + (i % 2) * 3)
		if not _shore_position(rock, target, -1.1, island, map):
			rock.free()
	source.free()

static func _blocked_box(box: AABB, map: IslandMap) -> bool:
	for z in range(floori(box.position.z), ceili(box.end.z)):
		for x in range(floori(box.position.x), ceili(box.end.x)):
			if x < 0 or z < 0 or x >= map.field.width or z >= map.field.height:
				return false
			if not map.field.is_blocked(x, z) or map.cover[z * map.field.width + x] != 0:
				return false
	return true

static func _shore(island: HandmadeIsland, dressing: Node3D, map: IslandMap) -> void:
	var shore: Node3D = dressing.get_node("Shore")
	for spec: Array in [
		["stranded_hull", Vector2(110, 216), -0.35, -0.45],
		["driftwood", Vector2(151, 214), 0.8, -0.32],
		["driftwood", Vector2(104, 216), -0.6, -0.32],
		["fallen_fishing_net", Vector2(113, 216), 0.3, -0.2],
		["crooked_dock_post", Vector2(117, 221), 0.15, -0.4],
		["crooked_dock_post", Vector2(139, 222), -0.15, -0.4],
	]:
		_place_shore(spec, shore, island, map)
	for point: Vector2 in [Vector2(148, 218), Vector2(108, 152), Vector2(146, 139)]:
		_place_shore(["dead_tree", point, 0.4, -0.35], dressing.get_node("HorrorOnly"), island, map)

static func _place_shore(spec: Array, parent: Node3D, island: HandmadeIsland, map: IslandMap) -> void:
	var target: Vector2 = spec[1]
	var node: Node3D = _piece(spec[0], parent, Vector3(target.x, 0, target.y), spec[2])
	if not _shore_position(node, target, spec[3], island, map):
		node.free()

static func _shore_position(node: Node3D, target: Vector2, min_ground: float, island: HandmadeIsland, map: IslandMap) -> bool:
	for radius in 16:
		for direction in 12:
			var p: Vector2 = target + Vector2.from_angle(direction * TAU / 12.0) * radius
			var position := Vector3(p.x, 0, p.y)
			var ground: float = map.ground_y(position)
			if ground < min_ground or ground > 0.2:
				continue
			var clear: bool = true
			for marker: Node3D in island.get_node("Markers").get_children():
				if Vector2(marker.position.x, marker.position.z).distance_to(p) < 7.0:
					clear = false
			if not clear:
				continue
			node.position = position
			node.position.y = ground - float(node.get_meta("ground_embed", 0.0))
			if _blocked_box(island._box_of(node), map):
				return true
	return false

static func _ground(island: HandmadeIsland, map: IslandMap) -> void:
	var terrain: Node = island.get_node("Terrain3D")
	var assets: Resource = ClassDB.instantiate(&"Terrain3DAssets")
	var sources: Array[String] = ["coast_sand_01", "rock_face_03", "aerial_grass_rock", "rocky_trail"]
	for i in sources.size():
		var asset: Resource = ClassDB.instantiate(&"Terrain3DTextureAsset")
		asset.set("name", ["Shore", "Cliffs", "Scrub", "Track"][i])
		asset.set("id", i)
		var texture_dir: String = DIR if i == 0 else "res://assets/textures/polyhaven/"
		asset.set("albedo_texture", load(texture_dir + sources[i] + "_albedo_height.res"))
		asset.set("normal_texture", load(texture_dir + sources[i] + "_normal_rough.res"))
		asset.set("uv_scale", [0.15, 0.2, 0.12, 0.3][i])
		asset.set("detiling_rotation", 0.3)
		assets.call("set_texture", i, asset)
	assets.take_over_path(DIR + "beach_01_ground.tres")
	_save(assets, assets.resource_path)
	terrain.set("assets", assets)
	var data: Object = terrain.get("data")
	var region: Object = data.call("get_region", Vector2i.ZERO)
	var height: Image = region.get("height_map")
	if height.get_width() != map.field.width or height.get_height() != map.field.height:
		_problems.append("Beach terrain and gameplay map dimensions differ")
		return
	var control := Image.create_empty(height.get_width(), height.get_height(), false, Image.FORMAT_RF)
	var colors := Image.create_empty(height.get_width(), height.get_height(), false, Image.FORMAT_RGBA8)
	var noise := FastNoiseLite.new()
	noise.seed = 20261114
	noise.frequency = 0.075
	for z in height.get_height():
		for x in height.get_width():
			var h: float = height.get_pixel(x, z).r
			var index: int = z * map.field.width + x
			var cell_height: float = map.heights[index]
			var slope: float = 0.0
			for offset: Vector2i in [Vector2i.LEFT, Vector2i.RIGHT, Vector2i.UP, Vector2i.DOWN]:
				var nx: int = clampi(x + offset.x, 0, map.field.width - 1)
				var nz: int = clampi(z + offset.y, 0, map.field.height - 1)
				slope = maxf(slope, absf(cell_height - map.heights[nz * map.field.width + nx]))
			var n: float = noise.get_noise_2d(x, z)
			var forest: float = 0.0
			for patch: Vector2 in [Vector2(80, 62), Vector2(176, 196), Vector2(160, 80), Vector2(80, 200)]:
				forest = maxf(forest, 1.0 - Vector2(x, z).distance_to(patch) / 30.0)
			var overlay: int = 2
			var base: int = 0
			var blend: float = clampf(forest + n * 0.25, 0, 1) if h > 0.6 else 0.0
			if slope > island.max_step:
				base = 1
				blend = 0.0
			elif map.cover[z * map.field.width + x] == IslandMap.COVER_ROAD:
				base = 3
				blend = 0.0
			var encoded: int = Terrain3DUtil.enc_base(base) | Terrain3DUtil.enc_overlay(overlay) | Terrain3DUtil.enc_blend(roundi(blend * 255))
			control.set_pixel(x, z, Color(Terrain3DUtil.as_float(encoded), 0, 0))
			var wet: float = lerpf(0.72, 1.0, smoothstep(-0.3, 0.65, h))
			var shade: float = wet * (0.98 + n * 0.035)
			colors.set_pixel(x, z, Color(shade, shade, shade, 0.5))
	data.call("import_images", [height, control, colors], Vector3.ZERO, 0.0, 1.0)
	data.call("save_directory", terrain.get("data_directory"))

## Reapply the beach pilot without rebuilding its authored layout.
const PATH: String = "res://game/world/handmade/islands/beach_01.tscn"
const BUILDER: Script = preload("res://tools/dev/beach_dressing.gd")

func _initialize() -> void:
	_run.call_deferred()

func _run() -> void:
	var original: String = FileAccess.get_file_as_string(PATH)
	var packed: PackedScene = load(PATH) as PackedScene
	if packed == null or original.is_empty():
		print("AUTHORING FAIL: beach scene could not load")
		quit(1)
		return
	var island: HandmadeIsland = packed.instantiate()
	var camera := Camera3D.new()
	root.add_child(camera)
	camera.position = Vector3(128, 50, 180)
	root.add_child(island)
	island.get_node("Terrain3D").call("set_camera", camera)
	await process_frame
	var problems: Array[String] = BUILDER.apply(island)
	if not problems.is_empty() or FileAccess.get_file_as_string(PATH) != original:
		print("AUTHORING FAIL: ", problems, "; scene changed externally or authoring failed")
		island.free()
		quit(1)
		return
	var resources: Dictionary = {}
	var targets: Dictionary = {}
	var indices: Dictionary = {}
	for group: String in ["Buildings", "Bridges", "Decor/Roads", "Rocks"]:
		for node: MeshInstance3D in island.get_node(group).find_children("*", "MeshInstance3D", true, false):
			var material: Material = node.material_override
			if material != null and material.resource_path.begins_with(BUILDER.DIR):
				var id: String = "beach_material_" + material.resource_path.get_file().get_basename()
				resources[material.resource_path] = id
				var path: String = str(island.get_path_to(node))
				targets[path] = id
				indices[path] = node.get_index()
	var additions: String = ""
	for path: String in resources:
		additions += '[ext_resource type="Material" path="%s" id="%s"]\n' % [path, resources[path]]
	additions += '[ext_resource type="PackedScene" path="%s" id="beach_dressing"]\n' % BUILDER.SCENE
	var owned_resources := RegEx.create_from_string('(?m)^\\[ext_resource[^\\n]* id="(?:beach_material_[^"]+|beach_dressing)"\\]\\n')
	var updated: String = owned_resources.sub(original, "", true)
	updated = updated.insert(updated.find("[sub_resource"), additions + "\n")
	updated = updated.replace('path="res://game/world/handmade/ground_assets.res"', 'path="' + BUILDER.DIR + 'beach_01_ground.tres"')
	var blocks: PackedStringArray = updated.split("\n[node ")
	var name_rx := RegEx.create_from_string('name="([^"]+)"')
	var parent_rx := RegEx.create_from_string('parent="([^"]+)"')
	var material_rx := RegEx.create_from_string('material_override = [^\n]+')
	var changed: Dictionary = {}
	for i in range(1, blocks.size()):
		var header: String = blocks[i].get_slice("\n", 0)
		var name: String = name_rx.search(header).get_string(1)
		var parent_match: RegExMatch = parent_rx.search(header)
		if parent_match == null:
			if not blocks[i].contains("metadata/beach_visual_pilot"):
				blocks[i] += "metadata/beach_visual_pilot = true\n"
			continue
		var parent: String = parent_match.get_string(1)
		var path: String = name if parent == "." else parent + "/" + name
		if targets.has(path):
			var override: String = 'material_override = ExtResource("%s")' % targets[path]
			blocks[i] = material_rx.sub(blocks[i], override) if material_rx.search(blocks[i]) != null else blocks[i] + override + "\n"
			changed[path] = true
		if parent == "Rocks":
			blocks[i] = blocks[i].replace("\nvisible = false\n", "\n")
	updated = "\n[node ".join(blocks)
	for path: String in targets:
		if not changed.has(path) and path.begins_with("Rocks/"):
			updated += '\n[node name="%s" parent="%s" index="%d"]\nmaterial_override = ExtResource("%s")\n' % [path.get_file(), path.get_base_dir(), indices[path], targets[path]]
			var instance_path: String = "/".join(path.split("/").slice(0, 2))
			if not updated.contains('[editable path="' + instance_path + '"]'):
				updated += '\n[editable path="%s"]\n' % instance_path
			changed[path] = true
	if changed.size() != targets.size():
		print("AUTHORING FAIL: not every material override could be persisted")
		island.free()
		quit(1)
		return
	if not updated.contains('name="Dressing" parent="Decor"'):
		updated += '\n[node name="Dressing" parent="Decor" instance=ExtResource("beach_dressing")]\n'
	updated = RegEx.create_from_string("\n{3,}").sub(updated, "\n\n", true)
	var output := FileAccess.open(PATH, FileAccess.WRITE)
	if output == null:
		print("AUTHORING FAIL: could not write beach scene")
		island.free()
		quit(1)
		return
	output.store_string(updated)
	output.close()
	print("Beach visual layer baked without rebuilding the layout")
	island.free()
	quit()

## The visual pilot must preserve the beach's exact pre-pilot gameplay grid.

const BEACH: String = "res://game/world/handmade/islands/beach_01.tscn"
const BASELINE: String = "res://tests/fixtures/beach_visual_baseline.json"
var _failures: int = 0

func _initialize() -> void:
	_run.call_deferred()

func _check(ok: bool, message: String) -> void:
	print(("TEST: " if ok else "TEST FAIL: ") + message)
	_failures += 0 if ok else 1

func _digest(value: Variant) -> String:
	var hash := HashingContext.new()
	hash.start(HashingContext.HASH_SHA256)
	hash.update(var_to_bytes(value))
	return hash.finish().hex_encode()

func _run() -> void:
	var parsed: Variant = JSON.parse_string(FileAccess.get_file_as_string(BASELINE))
	var scene: PackedScene = load(BEACH) as PackedScene
	if not parsed is Dictionary or scene == null:
		_check(false, "baseline fixture and scene load")
		quit(1)
		return
	var baseline: Dictionary = parsed
	var island: HandmadeIsland = scene.instantiate()
	var issues: Array[String] = []
	var map: IslandMap = island.build_map(issues)
	_check(issues.is_empty(), "dressed beach has no navigation problems")
	_check(_digest(map.field.blocked) == baseline.blocked, "blocking cells are identical to the original beach")
	_check(_digest(map.cover) == baseline.cover, "road and bridge walking surfaces are unchanged")
	_check(_digest(map.heights) == baseline.heights, "all gameplay ground heights are unchanged")
	var markers: Node = island.get_node("Markers")
	var unchanged: bool = markers.get_child_count() == baseline.markers.size()
	for marker: Node3D in markers.get_children():
		var before: Array = baseline.markers.get(str(marker.name), [])
		unchanged = unchanged and before.size() == 3
		if before.size() == 3:
			unchanged = unchanged and marker.position.distance_to(Vector3(before[0], before[1], before[2])) < 0.00001
	_check(unchanged, "every objective, choke, arena, spawn and boat marker is unchanged")
	var dressing: Node3D = island.get_node_or_null("Decor/Dressing")
	_check(dressing != null, "the normal route island includes its persistent visual layer")
	if dressing != null:
		_check(dressing.get_node("RockSurfaces").get_child_count() >= 4, "prepared realistic outcrops dress the already-blocked coast")
		_check(dressing.get_node("Shore").get_child_count() >= 4, "the coast contains actual wreckage, netting and timber")
		_check(dressing.get_node_or_null("Facades") != null and dressing.get_node("Facades").get_child_count() >= 20,
			"village facades contain authored windows, doors and coastal details")
		var misplaced: int = 0
		var floating: int = 0
		for group: String in ["Shore", "RockSurfaces", "HorrorOnly"]:
			for prop: Node3D in dressing.get_node(group).get_children():
				var box: AABB = island._box_of(prop)
				var embed: float = prop.get_meta("ground_embed", 0.0)
				floating += 1 if absf(box.position.y - map.ground_y(prop.position) + embed) > 0.01 else 0
				if group == "RockSurfaces":
					floating += 1 if box.end.y < map.ground_y(prop.position) + 0.5 else 0
				for z in range(floori(box.position.z), ceili(box.end.z)):
					for x in range(floori(box.position.x), ceili(box.end.x)):
						if not map.field.is_blocked(x, z) or map.cover[z * map.field.width + x] != 0:
							misplaced += 1
		_check(misplaced == 0, "every solid coastal prop, outcrop and horror tree stays off playable surfaces")
		_check(floating == 0, "coastal props and trees stand on their actual ground, with no floating bases")
		var hidden: int = 0
		for rock: Node3D in island.get_node("Rocks").get_children():
			hidden += 0 if rock.visible else 1
		_check(hidden == 0, "original blocking rocks remain visible at their full gameplay silhouette")
		var boxes_before: Array[AABB] = island.object_boxes()
		dressing.free()
		var bare: IslandMap = island.build_map()
		_check(bare.field.blocked == map.field.blocked and bare.cover == map.cover and island.object_boxes() == boxes_before,
			"removing the visual layer preserves the original navigation and obstacle boxes")
	var walls: MeshInstance3D = island.get_node("Buildings/Hut_01/Body")
	var material: StandardMaterial3D = walls.material_override as StandardMaterial3D
	_check(material != null and material.albedo_texture != null and material.normal_enabled,
		"village plaster has real colour and normal textures")
	var correct: bool = true
	var expected: Dictionary = {"Body":"white_plaster_02", "Roof":"clay_roof_tiles_02"}
	for house: Node3D in island.get_node("Buildings").get_children():
		for part: MeshInstance3D in house.get_children():
			if house.name.begins_with("Hut_") and expected.has(str(part.name)):
				correct = correct and part.material_override.resource_path.ends_with(expected[str(part.name)] + ".tres")
	correct = correct and island.get_node("Buildings/Tower_01/Body").material_override.resource_path.ends_with("stone_wall_02.tres")
	for bridge: MeshInstance3D in island.get_node("Bridges").get_children():
		correct = correct and bridge.material_override.resource_path.ends_with("weathered_planks.tres")
		for rail: MeshInstance3D in bridge.get_children():
			correct = correct and rail.material_override.resource_path.ends_with("weathered_planks.tres")
	for rock: Node3D in island.get_node("Rocks").get_children():
		for part: MeshInstance3D in rock.find_children("*", "MeshInstance3D", true, false):
			correct = correct and part.material_override != null and part.material_override.resource_path.ends_with("rock_face_03.tres")
	_check(correct, "all facade, roof, bridge and rock materials survive a fresh scene load")
	var assets: Resource = island.get_node("Terrain3D").get("assets")
	_check(assets.call("get_texture_count") >= 3, "the pilot terrain has separate sand, rock and ground textures")
	_check(assets.resource_path.ends_with("dressing/beach_01_ground.tres"), "the beach owns its terrain material set")
	var formats_match: bool = true
	var first_format: int = -1
	for texture: Resource in assets.call("get_texture_list"):
		var albedo: Texture2D = texture.get("albedo_texture")
		var normal: Texture2D = texture.get("normal_texture")
		if first_format < 0:
			first_format = albedo.get_image().get_format()
		formats_match = formats_match and albedo.get_width() == 1024 and normal.get_width() == 1024
		formats_match = formats_match and albedo.get_image().get_format() == first_format and normal.get_image().get_format() == first_format
	_check(formats_match, "all terrain array textures match in 1K dimensions and GPU format")
	island.free()
	for biome: String in ["town", "jungle", "port", "volcano"]:
		var other: HandmadeIsland = load("res://game/world/handmade/islands/" + biome + "_01.tscn").instantiate()
		var other_assets: Resource = other.get_node("Terrain3D").get("assets")
		_check(other_assets.resource_path.ends_with("handmade/ground_assets.res"), "%s keeps its original shared terrain assets" % biome)
		other.free()
	_check(HandmadeIsland.island_paths(&"beach").size() == 1, "the visual scene is not accidentally included as another route island")
	GameInput.setup()
	for atmosphere: StringName in [&"normal", &"horror"]:
		var context := RunContext.new(7)
		context.biome = &"beach"
		context.atmosphere = atmosphere
		var world: Node3D = load("res://game/world/island.tscn").instantiate()
		world.set("handmade_scene", load(BEACH))
		world.set("context", context)
		root.add_child(world)
		await process_frame
		var authored: Node3D = world.get("_handmade")
		_check(authored.get_node("Decor/Dressing/HorrorOnly").visible == (atmosphere == &"horror"),
			"dead-tree dressing follows the actual %s gameplay preset" % atmosphere)
		_check(world.get("_building_boxes").size() > authored.object_boxes().size(),
			"the actual camera also avoids the decorative props in %s" % atmosphere)
		var cover: BeachVegetation = world.get("_vegetation")
		var grass: MultiMeshInstance3D = cover.get("_grass")
		_check(grass.multimesh.mesh.get_faces().size() > 6,
			"the pilot uses tapered grass blades instead of solid rectangular cards")
		world.free()
		await process_frame
	quit(1 if _failures > 0 else 0)
